raw_response:
I am young and my plot is small, only 0.08 hectares, but maize is our food so I must do my best. I got a FISP coupon this season, so I will use the subsidized NPK and urea on this plot — since the package is meant for bigger land, on my small piece it will go far. I will also put some manure from the goats we keep, and plant hybrid seed from the coupon together with pigeon pea between the rows. I cannot afford to hire much labor, so I will work with my own hands and maybe ask one person for a day or two during weeding.
